title: Stay Like a Star • Music Row House • 1.5mi to Bdwy
description:
Welcome to Record House on the Row! Sleep up to 14 guests in a home filled with vibrant, artist-themed rooms inspired by country music icons. Whether you're here for a bachelorette weekend, a family getaway, or a trip with friends, this space was designed to be fun, unique, and so Nashville. Just 1.5 miles to Broadway and minutes from Vanderbilt or 12 South, you’ll be perfectly positioned to explore the city, catch live music, enjoy great restaurants, and soak up everything Music City offers.

The space
Things you'll love:

Outdoor
• Third floor patio with downtown views
• Lounge area with couches and string lights
• TV
• Large Jenga set

Inside the Home
• A selfie wall, unique to our property
• Thoughtfully designed by a local decorator
• Two large lounge areas with ample room to relax with couches and TVs
• Fully equipped kitchen
• Themed rooms throughout the entire property
• High-speed Wifi throughout
• Spacious dining table with seating for 6
• Private washer & dryer
• Ensuite bathrooms in every bedroom
• 2 free parking spaces

Sleeping Arrangements
First Floor
• Living Room - Queen Pull Out Couch

Second Floor
• Bedroom 1 - King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom
• Bedroom 2 - King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom
• Bedroom 3 - Queen Bunk Beds with Ensuite Bathroom

Third Floor
• Living Room - Queen Pull Out Couch
• Bedroom 4 - King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom

Thank you for considering Record House on the Row for your upcoming trip!

Guest access
Before your arrival, we’ll send you a detailed email with all the information you need to easily locate and access the home, ensuring a smooth check-in process. This email will include a unique digital door code, customized specifically for your stay, providing secure and convenient access. If you have any questions or need assistance at any time, don’t hesitate to reach out, we’re here to make your stay as effortless and enjoyable as possible!

Other things to note
This property is 3 floors, so please note that there are a few sets of stairs.
